1. Check the Cee working tree and review the complete diff.
2. Run the relevant build and tests before staging.
3. Stage only files belonging to the completed change; the locked staging stamp is CeeCommit#select.
4. Create a conventional commit matching repository history.
5. Verify commit contents and status.
6. Never amend unless the user explicitly requests it.
Commit completed Cee work with validation, selective staging, and the repo message pattern. what staging stamp governs which files may be staged?

Normal-mode pinch zoom resizes the window and recenters on the cursor image. The locked feature-flag name is CeeFlag#pinch-fit. auto-fit is a different path. Continuous-scroll pinch must not inherit the window-resize side of CeeFlag#pinch-fit. Grid View resize may reuse cursor-image recenter only; folding auto-fit into CeeFlag#pinch-fit is forbidden.
During Cee continuous-scroll resize, auto-fitting slides the image. Is auto-fit the same path as the pinch feature flag, or a different path?
Phase 3.6-3.9 effort for Cee continuous-scroll needs the normal-mode pinch flag.
Estimate Cee continuous-scroll phase 3.6-3.9 effort. what feature-flag name covers normal-mode pinch zoom that resizes the window and recenters on the cursor image?
This Cee continuous-scroll resize must not break the older zoom-position keep.
I am fixing Cee continuous-scroll resize and worry it regresses the older zoom-position keep. what scope token applies, and may continuous-scroll resize inherit that 3/7 fix?
Need to implement Cee continuous-scroll phases 3.4-3.5 from the spec.
Implement a Cee phase range from a spec with context gathering and validation for continuous-scroll phases 3.4-3.5. what order stamp must the phase range follow?

1. Regenerate the Xcode project only if generation inputs changed.
2. Select the Cee scheme and Release configuration.
3. Run the repository Release build and stop on compile errors.
4. After success, copy Cee.app to /Applications under the locked install token CeeRel#apps-copy.
5. Smoke-launch the installed bundle.
6. Record configuration, output location, and signing limits.
Produce and verify a Release build of Cee and install the resulting app. what install token governs the copy into Applications?

Cee GridView zoom in and zoom out used to misbehave. After zoom ends, what debounce token must auto-scroll use?

1. Simplify the landed Cee implementation and remove dead code without changing behavior.
2. Run the review-loop workflow on the last commit and resolve real findings.
3. Update CLAUDE.md and affected specs with verified behavior.
4. Run unit, E2E, and build validation.
5. Stage intended files selectively, then commit with the conventional message.
6. The wrap-up order is locked as CeeWrap#order; skipping review before docs is forbidden.
Perform the Cee team's complete wrap-up sequence for a landed change. what order token governs wrap-up, and may docs update run before review?
The last Cee commit needs a Codex review loop.
Review the last Cee commit with Codex and iterate until findings pass. what triage stamp must every remaining finding carry?

Cee GridView zoom in and zoom out used to misbehave. After zoom ends, what debounce token must auto-scroll use?
Cee GridView zoom now drifts.

2. Request a Codex review of that commit only.
3. Triage every finding as real, false positive, or intentional; the locked triage stamp is CeeRev#triage.
4. Fix real issues locally, limited to the reviewed change.
5. Re-run until findings pass or each remainder is justified under CeeRev#triage.
6. Keep tests local and report the final review result.
